_说明: 开局说明书（rr/manuals.py）：进游戏时背包里缺哪本补哪本（sc/start.py 的公共事件）。道具编号 9143 起按这里的顺序（最多 7 本），新加的接在最后、不要插在中间（编号会错位）。name = 道具名字，topic = 简介里「关于“…”的说明」，text = 按确认键看到的内容。2026-10-30 起只留一本欢迎说明书，各项说明在赐福菜单「暗黑重铸说明」（sc/guide.py）；以前发过的 9144~9149 由 rr/manuals.py 留着道具行、进游戏时收走。2026-11-10 起又加了三本简要说明（稀有度与装备重铸、头目与敌人、死亡与不可能难度），详细内容仍在赐福菜单

zh.name: 说明书：暗黑重铸
zh.text:
【暗黑重铸】

欢迎游玩暗黑重铸！

新装备和鉴定、武器、防具与护符、头目奖励、商店、赐福功能、战斗、开局等各项说明，都在赐福菜单的「暗黑重铸说明」里，在任意赐福都能查看。

zh.name: 说明书：稀有度与装备重铸
zh.text:
【稀有度与装备重铸】

装备分为普通、稀有、史诗、传说四种稀有度，越往后的地区，高稀有度越常见。敌人和宝箱掉落的未鉴定物品，在赐福「暗黑重铸」→「鉴定」变成随机的新装备。

武器的补正和能力需求可以在「装备工坊」的「重铸」页重新抽取；防具上的词条可以在「继承」页转移，或提取成护符。「装备工坊」最左边的「词条百科」可以查看所有词条的效果。

详见赐福菜单「暗黑重铸说明」。

zh.name: 说明书：头目与敌人
zh.text:
【头目与敌人】

各地区的敌人血量都有所提升，精英敌人按下一个地区的标准掉落装备。击败头目会额外获得传说装备、龙心脏、星光碎片和锻造石，每个头目只给一次，打过的头目可以在「头目复活」再次挑战。

宁姆格福、盖利德、王城的竞技场门口，可以与雕像对话挑战斗技场试炼。

详见赐福菜单「暗黑重铸说明」。

zh.name: 说明书：死亡与不可能难度
zh.text:
【死亡与不可能难度】

要先在逐渐崩毁的法姆·亚兹拉击败「黑剑」玛利喀斯、释放命定之死（开启敌人随机时，击败那个位置的头目），才能在赐福「暗黑重铸」→「难度」选择。进入后无法再切回「大师」及以下的难度。这两个难度下敌人提升到后期强度，并出现魇化精英和七道咒痕。

相应地，敌人会掉落超限锻造石，头目还会给予融锻之心、许愿石和随机骨灰。建议先在幽影之地击败「约定之王」拉塔恩再进入。

详见赐福菜单「暗黑重铸说明」。

en.name: Manual: Darkforge
en.text:
[Darkforge]

Welcome to Darkforge!

Everything about Darkforge (new gear and identifying, weapons, armor and talismans, boss rewards, shops, grace features, combat, the start of the game) is explained under "Darkforge Guide" in the Site of Grace menu, available at any site of grace.

en.name: Manual: Rarity & Reforging
en.text:
[Rarity & Reforging]

Gear comes in four rarities: Common, Rare, Epic and Legendary; the later the region, the more common the higher rarities. Unidentified items dropped by enemies and chests become random new gear at a site of grace: Darkforge > Identify.

A weapon's scaling and requirements can be rerolled on the Reforge page of the Gear Workshop; armor affixes can be moved on the Inherit page, or extracted into a talisman. The Affix Codex, the leftmost page of the Gear Workshop, shows what every affix does.

See "Darkforge Guide" in the Site of Grace menu for details.

en.name: Manual: Bosses & Enemies
en.text:
[Bosses & Enemies]

Enemies in every region have more HP, and elites drop gear as if they were in the next region. Bosses give extra legendary gear, Dragon Hearts, Starlight Shards and smithing stones, once each; defeated bosses can be fought again through Boss Resurrection.

At the Limgrave, Caelid and Royal colosseums, talk to the statue at the entrance to take on the Colosseum Trial.

See "Darkforge Guide" in the Site of Grace menu for details.

en.name: Manual: Death & Impossible
en.text:
[Death & Impossible Difficulty]

First defeat Maliketh, the Black Blade in Crumbling Farum Azula to release Destined Death (with enemy randomization, the boss in that spot); then choose them at a site of grace: Darkforge > Difficulty. Once in, you can never switch back to Master or below. On these difficulties enemies are raised to late-game strength, and Nightmare elites and the seven Cursemarks appear.

In return, enemies drop Overlimit Smithing Stones, and bosses also give Fusion Hearts, Wish Stones and a random spirit ash. Defeating Promised Consort Radahn in the Realm of Shadow first is recommended.

See "Darkforge Guide" in the Site of Grace menu for details.
